title: Line Reader
prompt:
Write a program that reads a line of text from the user and prints it back out.
Sample Input: Hello, World!
Sample Output: Hello, World!
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's a simple Python program that meets your requirements:

```python
# Read a line of text from the user
user_input = input("Please enter some text: ")

# Print the user's input back out
print(user_input)
```

When you run this program, it will prompt the user to enter some text. Once the user enters a line of text and presses Enter, the program will print that line back out to the console. Here's an example of how it might look:

```
Please enter some text: Hello, World!
Hello, World!
```
